embedded.title: Filesystem access control list
embedded.description: Manage the discretionary and/or system access control list of a local file or folder.

path.title: Path
path.description: The path to the local file or folder.

accessControlList.title: Access control list
accessControlList.description: The discretionary (DACL) and/or system (SACL) access control list for the file or folder. Omitting a section leaves it unmanaged; at least one section must be present.

discretionary.title: Discretionary access control entries
discretionary.description: The discretionary access control list (DACL) entries. Omit to leave the DACL unmanaged.

discretionaryProtected.title: Discretionary access control list is protected
discretionaryProtected.description: Whether the DACL is protected from inheriting entries from its parent. Omit to leave the current protection state unchanged when 'discretionary' is not provided, or to request an unprotected (inheriting) DACL when it is.

system.title: System access control entries
system.description: The system access control list (SACL) entries. Omit to leave the SACL unmanaged. Reading or writing this section requires the SeSecurityPrivilege privilege.

systemProtected.title: System access control list is protected
systemProtected.description: Whether the SACL is protected from inheriting entries from its parent. Omit to leave the current protection state unchanged when 'system' is not provided, or to request an unprotected (inheriting) SACL when it is.

_purge.title: Purge supplied sections
_purge.description: Whether to replace (purge) each supplied section outright, or merge its entries into the section's current managed entries. Defaults to true (replace) when omitted. When false, the entries supplied for a section are merged into that section's existing entries: semantic duplicates (same normalized principal, ACE type, effective access mask, and inheritance/audit flags) are not duplicated, and the resulting discretionary section is canonicalized with every 'deny' entry before every 'allow' entry. A section that is omitted from the request remains unmanaged regardless of this setting.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: The security principal the entry applies to. Accepts either a SID string (for example 'S-1-5-32-544') or an account or group name (for example 'DOMAIN\User' or 'Administrators'). Names are resolved to a security identifier; output always reports the normalized SID string.

type.title: ACE type
type.description: Whether the entry allows, denies, or audits access. 'allow' and 'deny' are valid only in the discretionary list; 'audit' is valid only in the system list.

accessMask.title: Access mask
accessMask.description: The permissions granted, denied, or audited by this entry.

flags.title: ACE flags
flags.description: Inheritance flags for the entry. Defaults to an empty list (no inheritance).

auditFlags.title: Audit flags
auditFlags.description: The audit conditions for the entry. Required (and non-empty) when 'type' is 'audit'; must be empty otherwise.
